title: Wow. Just wow.
excerpt: Wow. Just wow. The Franciscan Action Network touches on what I wish America could be … and names why I am so brokenhearted about the ugly side of our nation that needs to be left behind. Please share this widely. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qsZl1kUXV5I&feature=youtu.be
body:
